description: This file defines a custom exception class TransactionBeforePivotDateNotAllowed for the Fineract project, used to indicate that a transaction was attempted before the allowed pivot date in a savings account context.

classes.name: TransactionBeforePivotDateNotAllowed
classes.description: A custom exception class used to signal that a transaction occurred before the allowed pivot date in a savings account.

methods.name: TransactionBeforePivotDateNotAllowed
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific error message details including the transaction date and interest posting date.
